## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] GDDR7 memory employs PAM3 signaling to transfer 3 bits over 2 cycles per pin, reaching 32 Gbps pin rates and 1024 GB/s aggregate bandwidth across a 256-bit memory controller. (high confidence) — https://www.jedec.org/standards-documents/docs/jesd239 · keywords: GDDR7 Channel Bandwidth and Peak Throughput · also: https://github.com/tinygrad/tinygrad
- [statement] For models fully resident in GDDR7 VRAM (such as Gemma 4 12B at 7.8 GB), sustained memory bus utilization achieves 80-85% of theoretical bandwidth, delivering 85-92 tokens per second. (high confidence) — https://www.jedec.org/standards-documents/docs/jesd239 · keywords: GDDR7 Channel Bandwidth and Peak Throughput · also: https://github.com/tinygrad/tinygrad
